summary: Candidate is a narrower knowledge_reference focused on policy violation context within the same route_leak_analysis task family. Peer candidate 4872c923 (Route Leak Type Classification) is the broader, more complete taxonomy covering six documented types with explicit workflow steps for offending AS identification, route origin, and destination mapping. The candidate's 'policy violation context' framing is a semantic subset of the peer's comprehensive classification framework. Both are session-level knowledge_references in incident_assessment stage. Merge candidate into the existing broader skill to avoid fragmentation of the route leak taxonomy.
